text: You hold AppModel.swift. Please make a one-line change for T-DZBYH: in tabLabel(_:), delete the line 'if session.slot == nil, let goal = focus?.goal?.heading { return goal }'. Why: a fresh main session with no task of its own falls back to the project's goal, so a new empty session reads 'fresh session swaps'. With the line gone it reads the project name, which matches SessionStrip ('with no task, nothing project-wide stands in'). Reply when done.
